Our band for Senior IR Engineer is 160-200k base, typical sign-on is 0-10k. He also asked for an equity refresh relative to a recent dip in his current comp.

- Base >= $215k or a meaningful sign-on
- Clear timeline (they need decision by 3/11)

Monica, Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up, Tina (and hi Tina). Quick summary from my side: candidate is strong, headcount is approved for Q1 (we're green for this role). The ask exceeds our published band by ~15-35k depending on target. Two options I see that would be reasonable as a compromise:

Option A — Band-compliant base + larger sign-on + 1-year restricted equity refresh (one-time grant as retention):
- Base: $200k (top of band)
- Sign-on: $25k (prorated over 12 months)
- Equity refresh: one-time 4k RSU refresh vests over 12 months

Option B — One-time out-of-band base exception:
- Base: $215k (mid out-of-band)
- Sign-on: $10k
- Equity: standard offer

We need a formal comp-exception approval for Option B (out-of-band). For Option A we still need VP and Finance sign-off for sign-on + equity refresh. Given the candidate deadline (3/11) we should decide by EOD 3/5 to give TA time to get DocuSign in candidate's hands.

I've attached a blank comp_exception_form for routing if we go Option B. Please reply with preferences + any budget constraints. If both approve, I'll escalate to Markus for VP sign-off.

Best,
